notes: Deck slot 5 (prepCard, Chapter Briefing), scoped to celeste:c8. Composition approved by Pierre 2026-07-30.

Items are the chapter's in-scope objectives at chapter granularity — one line per collectable class with its count, plus the side clears and any Heart Door that gates them — not one line per individual collectable. The per-berry detail lives in the chapter strawberry table and the route.

Each item names the achievement it pays out, where there is one. Chapter counts come from the chapters dataset and the checkpoint split from the checkpoints dataset; locations and methods are condensed from the same source text the route steps use.
Mechanics introduced are deliberately not items here — they are not things you tick off. They stay in the chapter intro on the spine.
